items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I remember going out on a gig with J. C. Higginbotham, and PeeWee Russell, and Buck Clayton

ctx.x: So you did a few appearances then after '56?

Yeah, with a group that was going to go someplace and do something. I remember going out on a gig with J. C. Higginbotham, and PeeWee Russell, and Buck Clayton and some other guys, and I was - I didn't have a hard case for my horn, I just had a cloth case made for it. And my valve trombone wound up on the bottom of the rest of the instruments and boy was it mangled all up. So I thought they was just trying to put me out of business. I was getting too good for them. But I finally gave it away later to a young man,…

items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Louis Armstrong, Maxine Sullivan... 'Goin' Places' with Bing Crosby.

ctx.x: Your band wasn't working but Louis was working.
... Louis Armstrong, Maxine Sullivan... 'Goin' Places' with Bing Crosby.
But not the rest of the band? The rest of the band never appeared or played the score or anything like that in the movies?
